UPSC announces recruitment results for September 2026---Representational Photo Listen to this article 0.75x 1x 1.5x 00:00 / 00:00 New Delhi, Oct 21: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) on Wednesday announced the recruitment results for September 2026, stating that several recruitment cases had been finalised during the month.
 Advertisment According to the Commission, the recommended candidates have been informed individually by post.
 The applications of other candidates were also duly considered; however, they could not be shortlisted for interviews or recommended for the respective posts, the UPSC said.
